analysis.reason: RSI 33.6으로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 전 29.4 대비 회복 시도. MACD 히스토그램은 -0.0003에서 0.0006으로 개선되었으나 여전히 음수 구간. SMA5, SMA20, EMA10, EMA20 모두 현재가 $0.06에 위치하며 단기 지지선 역할. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 0.54로 위축된 거래량은 추세 전환 동력 부족 시사. 52주 고가 대비 4.9% 위치로 여전히 낮은 수준. 52주 저가 $0.05, 스윙 지지선 $0.05, 피벗 S1 $0.05로 강력한 지지 구간 형성. 5일 고가 $0.06, 스윙 저항 $0.06, 피벗 PP $0.06으로 저항 구간 형성. 현재가 $0.06은 5일 고가, 스윙 저항, 피벗 PP와 일치. 5일 고가/저가 패턴은 $0.06/$0.05로 횡보 구간. 주봉 RSI 33.7, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -0.0017로 약세 구간 지속. ADX 49.0으로 뚜렷한 추세 존재하나, -DI 29.2가 +DI 15.4보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우세. CCI -47.9로 중립 구간, 스토캐스틱 %K 56.2, %D 46.2로 중립 구간 안착 시도. 4시간봉 RSI 48.6으로 중립 구간, MACD 히스토그램 -0.0001로 약세 전환. 종합적으로 과매도 구간 탈출 시도하나 거래량 부족 및 주봉 약세, 하락 압력 우세로 인해 추세 전환 확신 부족. 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 33.6, attempting to exit oversold after being at 29.4 five days ago. MACD histogram improved from -0.0003 to 0.0006 but remains negative. SMA5, SMA20, EMA10, EMA20 all at $0.06, acting as short-term support. Volume at 0.54 of 5-day average indicates lack of momentum for trend change. Price at 4.9% of 52-week high, still low. Strong support at $0.05 (52-week low, swing support, pivot S1). Resistance at $0.06 (5-day high, swing resistance, pivot PP). 5-day price pattern is sideways ($0.06/$0.05). Weekly RSI 33.7, weekly MACD histogram -0.0017 show continued weakness. ADX at 49.0 indicates a strong trend, but -DI (29.2) is higher than +DI (15.4), suggesting downward pressure. CCI at -47.9 is neutral, Stochastic %K at 56.2 and %D at 46.2 are attempting to stabilize in neutral territory. 4H RSI at 48.6 is neutral, 4H MACD histogram at -0.0001 has turned negative. Overall, attempting to exit oversold but lack of volume, weekly weakness, and downward pressure prevent confident trend reversal. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· 52-week position (4.9%): historically low price level.
[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0003→0.0006): improving but still negative, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $0.05, Middle band $0.06): approaching lower band, band width at 31.92% is relatively wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.05): based on 52-week low and Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance ($0.06): based on 5-day high and Pivot PP, potential for short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern ($0.06/$0.05): sideways range, lacking directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.54): below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI attempting to exit oversold, but lack of volume and weekly weakness prevent confident trend reversal; conditions for waiting are met.
